importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Federal Trade Commission, in coordination with other federal agencies, to submit a report to Congress on the ability of minors to access fentanyl through social media platforms. The direct effects are limited to the federal agencies compiling the study, consulting stakeholders, and publishing the report.
